dataList.content:
I've witnessed so many lights...
我曾见过无数的光芒……

So many colors...
无数的色彩……

And so many emotions.
以及无数的感情。

Everything that I had to witness drew my gaze away from the rest of the world.
因为不得不观望这一切，便无法再看向其他事物。

So, my world is nothing but a meaningless mess of confusing, patternless, and incongruent colors.
所以我所观望的世界仅是一片无意义而又绚烂的杂乱风景而已。

Sometimes I'd wonder...
偶尔我也会思考。

... what kind world reflects in the eyes of others.
他人所观望的世界，又是什么模样呢。

Just what kind of world do they live in, that they become so attached to these little, insignificant splotches in a myriad of colors?
他们的眼中究竟映出了何种风景，才能在如此之多的色彩中对着微小而细碎的事物或喜或忧呢。

Why concern yourself with the way mayflies live?
那些如蜉蝣般短暂的生命，根本不值得投以目光。
dataList.place:
Tiekan Temple Interior
铁槛寺 内部

dataList.content:
Their concern is only for what lies immediately before them; they are myopic, unable to see far enough to achieve anything of significance.
他们被眼前的事物所束缚，无法看穿未来，所以无法达成远大的志向，就这么结束了自己那短暂的生命。

Do you believe that Hongyuan could have risen to its present reputation and prosperity had it not been for the revered Xianren?
如果没有各位仙人，你觉得鸿园还能攀至如今的地位吗？

The other Nests would have destroyed and devoured us whole.
早就会被其他的巢分而食之了。

Hong Lu...
鸿璐先生，即便如此……

I know that not everything in your world was colorful. But...
哪怕你所观望到的并非全是鲜艳的风景……
You must've felt something. 鸿璐先生也一定有所感受。

Something that made you feel, like... a heart.
也就是……感受到了心的存在。

Do you believe so?
是这样吗？

But it slipped away from me so, so long ago.
但我已经失去它很久了。

And this place is too vast to find anything once lost.
这里太过宽阔了，就算去找寻也无处可觅。

<That's not true.>
<不。>

<I'm sure you'll find it again. As long you put your mind to it.>
<只要你想去找的话，就一定能找到的。>

<As long as your heart is truly in it.>
<只要你决心去找的话。>

Little Baoyu. Do not let these empty words stir you.
宝玉啊。你为何总在聆听那些空虚的话语呢。

What could a frivolous thing like your puerile heart possibly do... before the great will of Hongyuan...?
在鸿园的伟大意志下……你的心又能做到些什么呢……

Oh... Oh, revered Xianren of my heart... do you also believe that to be true...?
啊啊……仙人啊……我心中的仙人也是如此想法吗……

You understand...! You acknowledge and appreciate my life, all that time I've sacrificed for Hongyuan...!
仙人啊，您能理解的吧！我那为了鸿园而牺牲的人生……！

Hahahahahaha! The revered Xianren of my heart speaks!
哈哈哈哈！我心中的仙人开口了！

That I, following in the great will of Daguanyuan... shall be reborn...!
我遵从着大观园的伟大意志，将重生为更加尊贵……！高贵的……！

... Reborn as a mighty, noble, and... immortal being!
……永生不死的存在！
